description: Sends a project enquiry to Hilo Studio on behalf of the user (it reaches the team by email; they reply within 24 h and the user gets a confirmation email). ONLY call this after the user has explicitly confirmed they want to contact the studio and has given their name and email. Never invent contact details.

budget.description: Budget range, if the user mentioned one.

deadline.description: Desired timing or deadline, if mentioned.

email.description: The user's email, where the studio will reply.

interest.description: Package of interest if the user picked one (from hilo_get_pricing), 'custom' for bespoke work, or 'unsure'.

project.description: What they need: goals, context, what it's for. Use the user's own words.

user_confirmed.description: Must be true: the user explicitly agreed to send these details to Hilo Studio.

name: hilo_request_quote
title: Request a quote
